summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on data sharing from Ramboll, specifically addressing what data is being provided and if any reciprocal metrics are expected. It was clarified that Ramboll will provide the necessary data, and no immediate metrics are required in return.

A key technical point raised involved historical recalculation: If a frame classification shifts by more than 100 meters, it requires different data from Ramboll, necessitating a historical recalculation process.
decisions: Ramboll will provide the necessary data; no metrics are immediately required in return.
action_items: Discuss the scope of data requirements and potential historical recalculations (e.g., frame shifts > 100m) on a call.
